# CPU-only FAISS build for Quake. See LICENSE for the upstream license.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(faiss VERSION 1.8.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")
set(FAISS_OPT_LEVEL "generic" CACHE STRING "FAISS CPU optimization level")
if(FAISS_ENABLE_GPU OR FAISS_ENABLE_PYTHON OR FAISS_ENABLE_C_API OR FAISS_ENABLE_RAFT)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The bundled Quake comparison supports CPU C++ builds only.")
endif()
add_subdirectory(faiss)
